about: The Academy revision library: free Years 7-9 sheets. 'sheets' are built (academy/<id>.json + .pdf); 'planned' are the topics still to write, in the order to write them. Packs bundle built sheets.

7.blurb: The foundations: number, the first steps in algebra, fractions, shape and data.

8.blurb: Calculating with fractions and decimals, ratio and percentages, and the algebra that GCSE builds on.
planned: Area of triangles, parallelograms and trapezia
Angles in parallel lines and polygons

9.blurb: Getting GCSE-ready: powers, proportion, graphs, Pythagoras and the start of trigonometry.
planned: Equations with unknowns on both sides

packs.title: Year 8 Revision Pack 1
packs.text: All eight Year 8 sheets in one PDF: rounding, decimals, fractions, ordering, ratio, percentages, like terms, brackets.
